notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5750337/95a33899fc2e3bba81506a7a29b6cbc8329052a8.gif[/img]

Join Richard Flanagan, the creative director of Phosfiend Systems as he plays through the entirety of FRACT OSC while sharing behind the scenes insights into the making and story of this landmark indie videogame. We'll try and have the stream up all week, but you can also watch it on youtube here (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=NFeo0qAYQFo)

notes.title: Ask us questions for the FRACT OSC 10 year anniversary retrospective!
notes.content:
[h2]Hello longtime FRACT fans, we'd love your help![/h2]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5750337/95a33899fc2e3bba81506a7a29b6cbc8329052a8.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5750337/95a33899fc2e3bba81506a7a29b6cbc8329052a8.gif[/img][/url]

FRACT OSC's 10 year anniversary is coming up in April, and we're planning to put together a retrospective on the conception, development and release of FRACT. We intend to be quite candid and open open how this wild thing got made - from the team, tools and techniques employed, to the mistakes, missed opportunities and just where the heck we've been doing for a decade.

[h2]AND WE WOULD LOVE TO ANSWER QUESTIONS FROM THE COMMUNITY. [/h2]

So if you have anything you'd like us to answer, drop those questions here and we'll see if we can address them in this retrospective. We're not 100% sure what shape this will take, but we're working on it.

Thanks for being awesome!

Keep you posted

notes.title: FRACT OSC Playable on Steam Deck and it's ON SALE!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5750337/5fe7164ebe59519d37b3654b5bc2f00d0eacff52.gif[/img]

Hello Again!

More good news as FRACT OSC has been classified as Playable by the DeckLords at Steam! [b]ALSO, IT'S ON SALE! [/b]In our experience it runs quite great on Deck, and we think you'll enjoy FRACT on the go. While our experience doesn't 100% line up with Valve's assessment, we didn't want to hold up the approval process. 

Three points to note in it's playable status according to Valve:

[list]
[*] [b]This game sometimes shows mouse, keyboard, or non-Steam-Deck controller icons[/b] [i](the default controller bindings are visible in the menu, just navigate with the stick and use RB to 'click')[/i]
[*] [b]Entering some text requires manually invoking the on-screen keyboard[/b] [i](this only effects players who need to name/rename synth presets, likely a TINY fraction of players)[/i]
[*] [b]This game does not exit cleanly and may require you to manually quit via the Steam overlay[/b] [i](we have not seen this behaviour in hours of our own testing, but maybe we're the exception)[/i]
[/list] 
[b]For those of you that have FRACT'd on the go - have you seen the third behaviour with unclean exits?[/b] Before we push Valve to retest this one, we thought we'd ask you folks first!

Thanks,

The phosfiend team

notes.title: Superbrothers X phosfiend collab on JETT: The Far Shore + Given time
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5750337/c24404fa7dbe1915339ed46ebe203b2894550e50.png[/img]

phosfiend systems is excited to announce our collaboration with [url=https://store.steampowered.com/search/?developer=Superbrothers]Superbrothers[/url] on the expansion for their game [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1761600/JETT_The_Far_Shore__Given_Time/]JETT: The Far Shore[/url]. The initial release of JETT: The Far Shore was one of our favorite games of 2021, as it captures an amazing sense of momentum and flow, while also presenting a captivating sci-fi narrative in a unique and rich far away world.

When the opportunity came up to work with [url=https://store.steampowered.com/search/?developer=Superbrothers]Superbrothers[/url] (co-creators of the awesome [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/204060/Superbrothers_Sword__Sworcery_EP/   ]Sword & Sworcery EP[/url]) on the equally ambitious Given Time expansion, we eagerly hopped on board to help the talented JETT Squad to get this thing to the finish line. Our last-mile contribution was largely a mix of design and systems advising and you should [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1761600?emclan=103582791472437081&emgid=3404184263846060375]read a bit more about it here[/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5750337/ac9a98bf6c21c31ab1e1848fe7311c8e3009c827.gif[/img]

Without going into too much detail we can say that the Given Time expansion delivers on the promise that JETT: The Far Shore established in 2021. The flexibility and openness of its world and systems create something truly special that we think will really resonate with players.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1761600/JETT_The_Far_Shore__Given_Time/]JETT: The Far Shore + Given Time[/url] will be launching in early 2023, and we think if you like FRACT OSC, that JETT will resonate with you as well. In fact, the new  demo that lets you play the truly epic opening sequence of the game is available now. Be sure to wishlist the game to keep an eye on updates and the release!

Thanks,

phosfiend systems

notes.title: Steam Deck Compatibility update!
notes.content:
[h1]SYNTH ANYWHERE![/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5750337/6bbc2ffbb8f8d846232ac7777ff208846d7edfdf.gif[/img]

FRACT OSC has [b]not been[/b] officially Steam Deck Verified (yet) but we can [b]unofficially say it runs great[/b]! Decade old first person synthesizer walking simulators are probably not at the top of Valve's list, and we don't have the ability to push it through the process manually at the moment.

That said, based on our testing and a bunch of folks reaching out to us via email, dms and other means, we have every reason to believe it should work just fine on the deck. In fact, it's a pretty ideal platform for the game; just plug in a good set of headphones and get lost in this weird world we've built.

We've published a community control scheme that we feel is the best of both worlds, but please let us know if it can be improved.

Cheers,

Richard

notes.title: Humble Weekly Bundle collects seven beautiful games
notes.content:
Congratulations on surviving the Steam Winter Sale! (Alternatively: my commiserations on your wounded bank balance, but at least you have a load of new games to play.) If you thought that might be it for cheap PC games until Valve's annual Spring shindig, then boy were you wrong: here were are, just two days later, and Humble have come up trumps again. Their latest Weekly Bundle is all about 'eye candy' games, and to that end they've collected the scrumptious Year Walk, the lovely Lovely Planet, and handsome handmade shmup The Blue Flamingo, with Dust, Mind: Path to Thalamus, and poetic survival game Eidolon thrown in too if you choose to beat the average. Finally, a payment of $10 will secure a copy of musical puzzler FRACT OSC.

We don't have reviews of all these games up on the site, but if you're wondering what we thought of Lovely Planet, Dust or FRACT OSC, we were pleased, slightly more pleased, and a bit *does wavey hand motion* with them respectively. In a stroke of good fortune, I didn't own any of those games before purchasing this bundle, and I'm particularly looking forward to giving Eidolon a try. How about you?

notes.title: Indie MEGABOOTH - Solid Gold Collection, Now Available!
notes.content:
The Indie MEGABOOTH Solid Gold Collection is now available on Steam!
Includes: Guacamelee! Gold Edition, Hotline Miami, The Stanley Parable, Octodad: Dadliest Catch, Monaco: What's Yours Is Mine, FRACT OSC

You love indie games, and so do we. In fact, we love them so much, we've spent the last three years at shows like PAX, gamescom, and GDC doing all the heavy lifting so that indies would have a space to come and show their games for dedicated gamers like you.

Today, we are super excited to announce a whole new way for you to connect with your favorite indie devs: The Indie MEGABOOTH Solid Gold Collection. Think of it as the gaming equivalent of a prized box set from your favorite classic rock band, but without all the weird "lost tracks" from their freestyle-jazz period. Sound awesome? That's because it is awesome. And by buying this awesomeness you're not only helping to support the indie developers who made the games, you're also supporting the MEGABOOTH, so we can keep doing our thing and bringing you the best indie games, live, in person, at gaming conventions all over the world.
